title: Why can't I open a Gold Years Account?
summary: This document explains that you can’t open a Gold Years Account if you do not meet the minimum age requirement of 62 years. It instructs you to verify your profile date of birth against your ID, sign out and back in after a recent birthday, and contact support if the error persists.
